scope: Area-weighted reproducible STL inward-normal rays, opposite exit normal dot <-0.85. Finite samples include edge tapers, fillets, hole rims and intentional shaft flats; this is not a certified global minimum or a blanket 1.6 mm wall pass. Exact critical-feature dimensions are documented separately. Adaptive CAD quadrature is used because default volume integration differs on the trimmed BSpline body.
